settings.description: Holdout validation of the recipe this round converged on. STACK (constants only, no extra encode cost) = 4-bit luma / 3-bit chroma layout + aniso=1.2 + sel_hv=0.15 + scale_fit=2 + ac_nearest=1. REFINE (encoder compute, ~50x encode time) adds the perceptual pixel-domain coordinate descent: refine_passes=2 refine_grid=1 refine_obj=3 refine_wc=3 refine_dc=1 refine_scale=1. Every arm pins all four selection/encoder knobs explicitly: the incumbent is the PRE-adoption shipped format, and since §10 adopted this recipe as the defaults, an arm that omitted a knob would inherit the adopted value — which had made the hv0 arm byte-identical to the stack arm it was meant to contrast with.
